units.source_text: 写好后叫人送进帘内去。

en.t: After he finished writing it, he had someone carry it inside the curtains.

units.source_text: 大女公子一看，又是这一套，觉得讨厌，

en.t: When the elder princess looked at it, she saw it was the same old sort of thing again and found it tiresome,
but she still had no choice but to reply respectfully:
